title: Jackie Robinson Ballpark National Commemorative Site Act
official_summary:
Jackie Robinson Ballpark National Commemorative Site Act

This act designates the Jackie Robinson Ballpark in Daytona Beach, Florida, as the Jackie Robinson Ballpark National Commemorative Site. It also makes the site a part of the African American Civil Rights Network established under the African American Civil Rights Network Act of 2017.

In addition, the act directs the Department of the Interior to conduct a special resource study of the site to evaluate its national significance and determine the suitability and feasibility of designating the site as a national historic landmark.

summary.headline: A law that names the Jackie Robinson Ballpark in Daytona Beach, Florida, a national commemorative site and orders a federal study of its historic importance.
summary.what_it_does: The act designates the Jackie Robinson Ballpark in Daytona Beach, Florida, as the Jackie Robinson Ballpark National Commemorative Site. It adds the site to the African American Civil Rights Network. It also directs the Department of the Interior to study whether the site is nationally significant and whether it could become a national historic landmark.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 4, 2025. The official summary does not list a separate effective date.
